'''Stable Zone One''' was the area between two [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] where [[Starship/Legends|starships]] could pass safely. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] traversed one of these zones inside [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].
